summary: AI Workflow Lab presents a 3D marble machine simulation generated by Claude Fable 5.2 as a single HTML file without external libraries, where synthesized audio and marble collision physics are synchronized.
summaryEn: Procedural 3D Marble Machine Music Animation in HTML

post.originalText:
I asked Fable 5.2 for a video with music. It built the instrument first

It’s a marble machine in 3D. A sloped belt carries 244 marbles toward the edge, and each one drops onto a metal bar, a bass bar, a drum or a cymbal. The belt works as the sheet music, so you can read the next 3 seconds of the song on it before you hear them

There is no audio file anywhere. The sound is synthesized from the same list of 244 notes that moves the marbles, which is why every note lands on the exact frame of its impact. 13 bars at 100 BPM, 4 chords, and a run of 60 marbles in 9.6 seconds near the end

No samples, no 3D models, no libraries. From my message to the finished video took 45 minutes, and about 30 of those were rendering

sourceMaterials.text: @chenzhangreal Lol same. The good news is none of them are real, so nobody has to pick them up off the floor after the song ends
sourceMaterials.author: AIWorkflowX

sourceMaterials.text: @NeurallPulseAi It picked everything itself, I only asked for a video with music. It went with Am F C G at 100 BPM and kept the melody in C major pentatonic, which is probably why nothing sounds off even with 244 notes flying around
sourceMaterials.author: AIWorkflowX

sourceMaterials.text: @UP_SHIFTED That was my favorite part to watch come together. You can see the 60 marble run coming about 3 seconds early, a whole wall of them on the belt before the first one even drops
sourceMaterials.author: AIWorkflowX
